rules.text: Every stray has a tag. A real owner knows where and when they lost it.
rules.hint: If their story contradicts the tag, refuse.

rules.text: Trust the object, not the story. Liars only know what they can see. Ask about what's hidden.
rules.hint: Wrong about a hidden detail? Refuse.

rules.text: If it hums, it's home, whatever they say.
rules.hint: If it hums for them, return it, even if their story is muddled.

rules.text: Two people claiming one thing? Let the object decide.
rules.hint: The hidden details point to exactly one of them.

rules.text: The Grey Gentleman gets nothing. Not even the time of day.
rules.hint: Never return anything to Mr Vell.

rules.text: If it comes from tomorrow, it isn't lost yet. Lock it in the Iron Drawer, even if they're the owner.
rules.hint: Dated after today (check the calendar)? Put it on the tray and seal it.

rules.text: Frost means they've gone on ahead. Cold things go only to the cold.
rules.hint: Frosted objects go to visitors who frost the glass. Refuse the living.

rules.text: My blue lamp shows what ink tries to hide. Every Ninefold ticket has a date in blue.
rules.hint: While inspecting, press L to switch on the blue lamp.
